text:
maria.chen: Heads up: received weights+tokenizer from BlueForge for cobalt-11b-v2. Upload landed in secure staging: s3://redwood-staging/partners/blueforge/cobalt-11b-v2/ . Need provenance/registry handoff. Quick checklist I ran below.

samir: Thanks — first things first: sha256 checksum verification and signer metadata. Can you paste the checksum + signature blob?

maria.chen: Pasted.
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging/partners/blueforge/cobalt-11b-v2/cobalt-11b-v2.tar.gz .
sha256sum cobalt-11b-v2.tar.gz
# expected: 3f4b9d2a7c1f6e2ab0c4f9e7d2c3f1a9b0e4c6d7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4b5c6a7d8e
gpg --verify cobalt-11b-v2.tar.gz.sig cobalt-11b-v2.tar.gz
```
Tokenizer files: vocab.json (size 2.1MB), merges.txt (n/a for BPE-style), vocab_size=50288, special_tokens present. Also uploaded hf_config.json (commit: 8a7f3b).

registry-bot: Ingest ticket created: ingest_id=RF-2026-0042. Metadata stub: s3://redwood-registry/ingests/RF-2026-0042/metadata.json (will be populated).

oleg: Confirming KMS key used: proj-prod-llm-kms. I'll run decrypt in an ephemeral build box and checksum locally. @infra-ops can you approve ephemeral IAM role for this job?

infra-ops: Approved. Role 'llm-ingest-runner' granted for 2h. Audit logs streaming to s3://redwood-audit/ingest-logs/RF-2026-0042/. Please tag operations with the ingest id.

jing: Quick eval plan: smoke run with 200 golden prompts from eval-suite v2 (diverse Q/A + reasoning set). Measure avg_perplexity, exact-match on the spec subset, and median latency @ seq=128. After baseline, I'll queue quant experiments (4-bit then 8-bit fallback). When do you want those run?

samir: Priority=high (customer pilot). Tag the registry entry with 'pilot:blueforge' and 'quant-candidates:4bit,8bit'. Also capture hf_config commit hash (maria noted 8a7f3b). We should also record original_source_url + signer email in metadata.

maria.chen: Done: tags added to registry entry and model card draft uploaded at s3://redwood-model-cards/blueforge/cobalt-11b-v2.md. Ingest ID=RF-2026-0042. Starting smoke run now.

registry-bot: Smoke run complete for RF-2026-0042: 200 prompts -> avg_ppl=12.4, median_latency=88ms @ seq=128 on dev-rt-1. Delta vs ref 11b baseline: +0.3 ppl. No immediate quality regressions flagged. Logs and eval artifacts: https://internal.redwood/run/RF-2026-0042/logs

oleg: I'll start quantization experiments tomorrow morning. Plan: GPTQ-style 4-bit pass (candidate) with a quick token-diff report, then an 8-bit fallback if 4-bit crosses quality gate. I'll push quant artifacts to the registry under RF-2026-0042/quant/ with provenance.json attached.

maria.chen: Quality gate thresholds for this pilot: ppl <= ref +1.0 AND EM on the spec subset >= ref -2 points. If 4-bit fails, try 8-bit; if both fail, keep fp16 and mark quant=false. I'll own triage and sign-off for quality. Assigning provenance sign-off to @samir.

samir: Signed provenance log: signer=samir@redwood.internal, key=ed25519:abc123, signature_blob stored at s3://redwood-registry/ingests/RF-2026-0042/signature.sig. Once quant artifacts are pushed, I'll verify manifests and close the handoff.

maria.chen: :white_check_mark: All set for now. Keep this thread updated with each artifact push and any failing token-diff reports. RF-2026-0042
